p01.requiredOutcome: full uninterrupted parking footprint after old C01 decommissioning

alternatives.reason: Wet surface approach and 25 times more subsurface fluid than the selected east/north alternative.

alternatives.warning: The full study envelope is not an excavation release. Use the proven dry core and preserve the north buffer.

campusSeparation.rule: Keep z=-160..-141 as an unbuilt drainage, landscape and utility-separation buffer.

provenDryCore.programStrategy: Stack the preserved C01 program across three levels rather than copying the old horizontal shell.

optionalDryNorthModule.relationship: isolatable northern service/plant module; stays south of the mandatory campus buffer

levels.program: power, ventilation, water management, protected stores and maintenance
operations, communications, workshops, logistics and internal circulation
arrival, briefing, support, parking/loading interface and public-safe orientation

selectedReservation.concealmentRule: No concrete or liner may daylight. Require three solid terrain blocks above every roof cell after construction, with a five-block landscape transition at edges; low-cover cells are excluded or backfilled.

portalStudy.relationship: recessed west-facing entrance, physically separated from P01

roadStudy.requiredCharacter: landscaped descending east road with switchbacks, retaining walls, drainage and a portal forecourt hidden from P01
roadStudy.decision: Do not force a direct road. Design surveyed bridge/causeway and retained-cut segments, then prove grade, drainage, headroom and bidirectional movement before release.
roadStudy.parkingSeparationRule: The road begins outside x=125 and never occupies a P01 stall or circulation aisle.

tunnelAndPackageConflicts.ravenRock: No cataloged Raven Rock route intersects x700..900,z-160..5. The district-level Raven Rock record ends at x300.
tunnelAndPackageConflicts.dataCampus: No building overlap. Enforce the z=-160..-141 C01 no-build buffer against the campus whose nearest raw parcel edge is z=-180.
tunnelAndPackageConflicts.warehouse: No spatial overlap; warehouse expansion occurs below recovered P01 at x32..125,z200..296.
tunnelAndPackageConflicts.crossPackageRule: Re-run exact 3D target intersection against every operation file immediately before any coordinated release.

migrationDecision.prohibitedMethod: blind copy/translation of the old C01 block volume
sequence: Freeze old C01 and preserve all routes/program records.
Build dry isolated modules at the selected east reservation with exact-state guards.
Commission utilities, two independent exits, portal road, internal routes and concealment.
Migrate program and inventory through a controlled ledger.
Verify new database objects and matched evidence.
Decommission old C01 only after acceptance.
Restore P01 as a continuous parking surface and commission the recovered warehouse wings.
Retain exact rollback packages for every phase.

acceptance: continuous stall and aisle geometry across the full recorded P01 bounds
no C01 portal, shell, road or construction staging within P01
surface support and drainage census after old C01 decommissioning
vehicle route QA in both directions

warehouseExclusion.rule: No open excavation. Preserve a minimum five-block review halo around all listed source cells and prove bulkhead separation.

releaseGates: complete 3D feature, route and cross-package target intersection
repeated fluid and gravity census including one-cell and five-cell halos
fixed transaction order and exact rollback
matched concealment, portal, parking and warehouse evidence
